The bundled English traineddata model is from @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0, published by the Tesseract.js data project at https://github.com/naptha/tessdata.

The npm package metadata declares MIT. The upstream tessdata repository declares Apache-2.0. The Apache-2.0 license text is included in TESSERACT-CORE-LICENSE.txt; the traineddata is used as a local application resource.
